portfolio_manager.max_minutes_per_day_note: Never log a day past minutes_per_day in total (Monthly Timesheet Σ Hours); top up only the difference.

jira.auto_pick_jql: assignee = currentUser() AND statusCategory = "In Progress" ORDER BY updated DESC
jira.note: Disabled at the user's choice (portfolio manager only). Set enabled=true and issue_key (or keep auto_pick_jql) to also log in Jira; see reference/jira.md.

holidays_note: Bangladesh government public holidays (general + executive order), from the official 2026 list (The Daily Star, 2025). Moon-dependent dates may shift; correct them here if the government revises a date. Add each new year's list before logging that year.

holidays.2026-02-21: Shaheed Day and International Mother Language Day

office_hours.note: User's office time, Asia/Dhaka. Jira entries start at start; a day's logged time stays within these hours.
